q1_issues.issue: The matrix verb "performed" is not reified — "performed an autopsy" is collapsed onto the autopsy event-noun, but the light-verb carve-out is stated only for occurred / happened / took place, so a verbal clause here should reify its own event.
(Past sk_recover_1) puts a tense atom on the participial reduced relative "bodies recovered from beneath …", which the finite-clause-only tense rule bars.
"a layer of concrete" is encoded as (Member sk_layer_1 concrete), typing the layer itself as concrete rather than relating the layer to the substance.
(Member sk_layer_1 poured) moves the concrete's participial modifier onto the layer, and "freshly" is dropped entirely.

q2_gaps: a TRANSITIVE light verb over an event noun ("performed an autopsy", "conducted a search") — the light-verb rule covers only the intransitive occurred / happened / took place
a measure / container of-phrase ("a layer of concrete", "a cup of water") is explicitly excluded from the genitive rule but no replacement encoding is given

a cardinal partitive without a definite flag ("one of three bodies") — the partitive trigger list is "of the / of these / of those / of them", so it is unclear whether the subset+SubsetOf shape or an individual with PartOf applies
an adverb modifying an attributive participle ("freshly poured") has no licensed slot
notes: "a northwest Indiana home" follows the lowercase-adjective sub-region pattern exactly (witness zone + Member northwest + LocatedIn indiana + Name), though the proper-noun-premodifier rule would instead have called for Possession, and the two rules conflict here. FromBeneath is a legitimate CamelCase-joined multi-word preposition.
